lines.text: Many learners say: I drink coffee at the morning.
Better: I drink coffee in the morning.
In! I run in the morning.

native.tip: Говори “in the morning”: “I drink coffee in the morning.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “I drink coffee at the morning”? 😅 По-русски «утром» — без предлога, и хочется выбрать “at”, а нужно “in.” Правильно: “I drink coffee in the morning.” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “in.” Утром — in the morning. Скажи вслух: “I drink coffee in the morning.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: Say “in the morning”: “I drink coffee in the morning.”
en.caption: Do you also say “I drink coffee at the morning”? 😅 In Russian “in the morning” is one word with no small word, so “at” slips in, but English needs “in.” Correct: “I drink coffee in the morning.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
